connections.begin: E to center; render separately from Begin decoration

import_recipe.filtering: linear; preview at integer-aligned positions; nearest is inappropriate for these antialiased outlines
import_recipe.notes: 6 MiB conservative all-24 decoded estimate at scale2; engine font atlases, buffers and transient copies excluded. Source SVGs excluded by source-assets/.gdignore.

modes.2: one-color alpha silhouette; diagnostic/accessibility supplemental preview

appearance.disabled: reduced opacity plus disabled treatment and live label
appearance.unavailable: struck slot/slash plus unavailable live label
appearance.note: Interaction overlays are theme/consumer geometry, never copied glyph files. Monochrome mode1 is the preferred working monochrome; alpha-only mode2 loses interior detail.
appearance.monochrome_on_dark: mode1 with light ink and default black monochrome_paper
appearance.monochrome_on_parchment: mode1 with dark ink (#111b29) and light monochrome_paper (#e8d5aa); direct dark multiplication loses internal detail
